speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Health why CareShield Life is not replacing ElderShield for all Singaporeans with transitional subsidies to ease the shift, as was the shift from MediShield to MediShield Life in 2015.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Health how will the Government ensure that the CareShield Life scheme to be administered by the Government will be as or more cost-efficient as compared to ElderShield which is run by private insurers.
